visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman wearing red-rimmed glasses and a blue checkered apron over a white shirt is tasting soup from a white ceramic spoon. She shows a surprised and delighted facial expression in a bright, modern kitchen with white cabinets. (2) A top-down shot of a white bowl containing a piece of cooked chicken, bitter gourd, pineapple, and a clam. (3) Hands place dried shiitake mushrooms into a rectangular metal tray and pour warm water over them, then press them down with a white vacuum lid. (4) Raw chicken thighs are placed into a pot of cold water on a black induction stove; as it boils, foam rises to the surface. (5) The chicken is removed with chopsticks and placed into a stainless steel bowl of clean water, where hands meticulously wash the meat and bone crevices. (6) A whole pineapple is placed on a yellow cutting board and sliced into large chunks with a sharp knife; the skin and core are removed. (7) Slices of ginger are cut, and a white bitter gourd is halved, deseeded with a spoon, and cut into large crescent pieces. (8) The washed chicken, soaked mushrooms, ginger, bitter gourd, pineapple chunks, and dried small fish are layered into a large red enameled cast-iron pot. (9) Rice wine and water are added to the pot, which is then heated; foam is skimmed off with a mesh strainer before the lid is placed on. (10) After simmering, the red lid is lifted to reveal the bubbling soup; salt is sprinkled in, and fresh clams are added to the pot. (11) The woman is seen again, using chopsticks and a spoon to eat the chicken and bitter gourd, nodding in satisfaction and giving a thumbs up to the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 真的不蓋你！這是我喝過最好喝的鳳梨苦瓜雞. (2) [Slogan]: 夏天退火必喝！鳳梨苦瓜雞湯. [Slogan]: 湯頭鮮甜、又回甘❤️. (3) [Subtitle]: 乾香菇洗乾淨，溫水泡開，一旁備用. (4) [Subtitle]: 冷水放入帶骨雞腿. (5) [Subtitle]: 等湯上面佈滿浮沫，把雞肉夾起來放到溫水裡. (6) [Subtitle]: 清洗掉表面的雜質，骨頭縫裡也要洗乾淨喔. (7) [Subtitle]: 洗好後，泡一下水備用，避免雞肉脫水. (8) [Subtitle]: 鳳梨皮刷洗乾淨. [Subtitle]: 你可以請攤商幫你削，也可以自己削皮. [Subtitle]: 像這樣，把皮去掉就可以了. [Subtitle]: 然後再把鳳梨切成大塊一點. (9) [Subtitle]: 切幾片薑片. (10) [Subtitle]: 苦瓜去掉蒂，剖成對半. [Subtitle]: 用湯匙挖掉中間的囊籽. [Subtitle]: 白色內膜刮乾淨，這樣可以減少苦味. [Subtitle]: 再把苦瓜切成大塊狀. (11) [Slogan]: 需要文字食譜請留言 +1. [Subtitle]: 把帶骨雞腿放到鍋子裡. (12) [Subtitle]: 再放入泡好的香菇跟香菇水. [Subtitle]: 薑片、苦瓜跟一些鳳梨. (13) [Subtitle]: 還有這個秘密武器！丁香小魚乾. [Slogan]: 提升湯的鮮味！. (14) [Subtitle]: 適量的米酒，還有足夠的冷水. [Subtitle]: 開中火加熱. (15) [Subtitle]: 滾了之後撈掉浮沫，保持湯的清澈. (16) [Subtitle]: 轉小火，蓋上鍋蓋，燉煮30分鐘. (17) [Subtitle]: 好囉～開蓋～哇～非常清爽的感覺. (18) [Subtitle]: 來一點鹽調味. [Subtitle]: 最後呢，再放入蛤蜊提鮮. [Subtitle]: 煮到蛤蜊開口就可以關火了～. (19) [Subtitle]: 這個湯真的非常很好喝！❤️. [Subtitle]: 有鳳梨的甜香，苦瓜回甘的滋味❤️. [Subtitle]: 雞肉也燉煮的剛剛好！. (20) [Subtitle]: 大家一定要試試看喔！. [Slogan]: 更多美味料理請追蹤我 IG. [Logo]: 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房. [Logo]: YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with short dark hair and red-framed glasses, wearing a white T-shirt and a blue and white checkered apron.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly female voice introduces the dish with high positive valence over a bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar BGM. (2) Sound of water pouring into a metal tray with a resonant splash, followed by the dull thud of a lid being pressed. (3) Soft water bubbling and splashing sounds occur as chicken is placed in a pot and foam is skimmed. (4) Rhythmic, crisp chopping sounds on a wooden or plastic board emphasize the preparation of pineapple and bitter gourd. (5) Metallic clinks and sliding sounds as ingredients are placed into the enameled pot. (6) A distinct 'clack' sound when the heavy pot lid is placed on top. (7) High-frequency slurping sounds followed by an satisfied vocal exclamation ('Mmm') and a sharp clink of chopsticks hitting a ceramic bowl. (8) The voice concludes with an enthusiastic CTA while the BGM fades out with a final melodic flourish.
